new_agent_start.rule: Read AGENT_START_HERE.md first. You are one parallel agent, not the sole project owner. Do not claim or modify an occupied lane unless explicitly assigned.
resume_order: the assigned lane manifest and only relevant files/evidence
new_agent_start.branch_rule: For a new independent task, create a fresh branch from current main named agent/<short-lane-id>. Use agent/metadata only if it is still free when you begin.
new_agent_start.output_rule: Completed lane findings, status, evidence, tests, and complete build-request bundles may be published directly to main after creating a backup branch or recording the exact base commit and rollback path. Keep incomplete experiments on the assigned lane branch. Shared Surveyor releases are compiled and published by the primary integration assistant.
new_agent_start.autonomy_rule: Continue within the lane until the objective is complete, blocked on another lane, or genuine human/local-machine intervention is required.
